detailed_description: The Favicon Generator creates PNG favicon images from a local source image. Upload an image, select output sizes such as 16, 32, 48, or 64 pixels, generate previews, and download each PNG or all generated sizes. The page also creates simple HTML link tags for the generated PNG files so you can copy them into a project template. It is useful for quick favicon assets and prototypes. It does not currently package an ICO file or generate every platform-specific icon size.
usage_steps: Upload a source image from your device.
Choose the favicon sizes you want to generate.
Click Generate to create PNG previews.
Download individual sizes or download all generated PNG files.
Copy the suggested HTML link tags if they match your filenames.
Test the icons in your actual site or browser environment.
usage_examples: Create 16x16 and 32x32 PNG favicons from a square logo.
Generate a 64x64 icon for a browser tab or internal tool.
Copy link tags for quick insertion into an HTML template.
Preview whether a logo remains recognizable at small sizes.

faqs.question: What file type does the generator output?
faqs.answer: It outputs PNG favicon images for the selected sizes.

faqs.question: Does it create a .ico file?
faqs.answer: No. The current page generates PNG files and HTML link snippets, not an ICO package.

faqs.question: Which sizes can I generate?
faqs.answer: The visible options include common square sizes such as 16, 32, 48, and 64 pixels.

faqs.question: Can I download all generated icons?
faqs.answer: Yes. The page can trigger downloads for all generated PNG sizes.

faqs.question: Should my source image be square?
faqs.answer: A square source usually gives the cleanest favicon result because the canvas output is square.
